verdict.rationale: The 01 is an agent platform that executes code, manages files and controls third-party software, so approval gating for sensitive actions is a fair axis. The evidence documents no confirmation or approval step before execution. Editable profiles (system message, behavior) are at most an adjacent customization and do not earn credit.

support.subject: As an operator, sensitive actions (payments, sends, deletes) pause for my approval before the agent executes them
